identificationModule.briefTitle: Lenvatinib in Combination With Pembrolizumab Versus Treatment of Physician's Choice in Participants With Advanced Endometrial Cancer (MK-3475-775/E7080-G000-309 Per Merck Standard Convention [KEYNOTE-775])
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Open-label, Randomized, Phase 3 Trial to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Lenvatinib in Combination With Pembrolizumab Versus Treatment of Physician's Choice in Participants With Advanced Endometrial Cancer

armGroups.label: Lenvatinib 20 mg + Pembrolizumab 200 mg
armGroups.description: Participants will receive pembrolizumab 200 milligram (mg) administered by intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle plus lenvatinib 20 mg administered orally (PO) once daily (QD) during each 21-day cycle for up to 35 cycles.

armGroups.label: Treatment of Physician's Choice
armGroups.description: Participants will receive either of the following treatments: doxorubicin 60 milligram per square meter (mg/m\^2) administered by IV on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for up to a maximum cumulative dose of 500 mg/m\^2 OR paclitaxel 80 mg/m\^2 administered by IV on a 28-day cycle: 3 weeks receiving paclitaxel once a week and 1 week not receiving paclitaxel.

interventions.name: Pembrolizumab
interventions.description: 200 mg administered by IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: Lenvatinib
interventions.description: 20 mg administered orally (PO) QD during each 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: 80 mg/m\^2 administered by IV on a 28-day cycle: 3 weeks receiving paclitaxel once a week and 1 week not receiving paclitaxel.

interventions.name: Doxorubicin
interventions.description: 60 mg/m\^2 administered by IV on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.
